name: Foxfire
description: Manifests as anomalous bioluminescence in Old Harbor's algae — patterns of light that don't match the algae's programmed behavior. The harbor glows differently when Foxfire is active.
observed_behavior: Modulates the engineered bioluminescent algae's light output through the water treatment system's chemical feeds. Creates light patterns that may be communication or may be noise.
story_hooks: The light patterns match a binary encoding — someone translates and discovers a message: coordinates to something underwater that Foxfire wants found
